title: bakery-ops go-live checklist
description: Phase-5 plan 10.3. scripts/gate_check.py validates the file with the same rules (stdlib only, checklist_errors) and reads one row per item in --mode done.

id.description: unique in the file; a sign-off's file is docs/go-live/signoffs/<id>.md

required.description: false: a missing or failing item is a warning, never a blocker

ci_job_jobs.description: In CI (--ci) each job must be a need of the gate job (directly or through the jobs it needs), so the gate running at all proves them green; self is the gate job's own Pest step. Locally SKIP (trusted to CI).

ci_job_workflow.description: The newest successful run of the workflow (and job, matched by id or display name) on branch, read from the Actions API, finished within max_age_days before the reference time: now while the phase is open, done_at once claimed.

script.description: Runs the argument list (no shell) from the repository root; exit 0 is PASS, the last lines of its output are the detail.

file_exists.description: Every path exists and is not empty. With signoff: one path, docs/go-live/signoffs/<id>.md, with the fields item, date, signed_by and statement, every commit that touched it made in GitHub's web editor; a missing sign-off is WAIT, not FAIL.
